name: TSM Sub-3nm AI Semiconductor Foundry Monopoly Valuation
rationale: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSM) is the sole volume manufacturer of sub-3nm logic chips and CoWoS packaging required by every leading AI accelerator. TTM revenue reached $119.0B USD (+36.0% YoY) with 49.9% net profit margins. At $415.07 (forward P/E 19.06x), our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $658.83 (+58.7% upside at 7.00% discount rate). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in just 13.3% CAGR, well below consensus ($554.45 mean target). Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 3.0 shares, 3.85% target weight). Accumulate on pullbacks near $399.72, trim Tier 1 at $550.00+.

bear.rationale: Geopolitical risk discount persists; hyperscaler capex digestion slows leading-edge orders, revenue reaches $209.8B Y5 at 38% net margin.
risks: Taiwan Strait geopolitical tensions triggering valuation discount compression
Hyperscaler AI capex pause leading to temporary fab utilization drops

base.rationale: TSMC dominates sub-2nm (N2/A16) and CoWoS advanced packaging; pricing power drives revenue to $321.7B at 46% net margin.
risks: High capital expenditure costs for overseas fab construction in Arizona and Japan
Yield learning curves on 2nm GAA architecture

bull.rationale: Unprecedented multi-year AI accelerator demand wave; global fab expansion in US/Japan diversifies geopolitical risk; $442.0B revenue at 50% margin.
risks: Extreme concentration of global leading-edge AI compute dependencies
Water and electricity infrastructure constraints in western Taiwan
